metadata.description: lask's personal Claude Code skill pack.

plugins.name: lask
plugins.description: Six-agent roster (scout, researcher, implementer, reviewer, verifier, Codex second-opinion; opus except the sonnet implementer and the haiku Codex relay; effort pinned per role; workflow agent() calls must set effort explicitly), the TW Hybrid output style (selected by /lask:doctor --install), the review-loop skill (isolated adversarial review by two or more model families, adjudication, validated judge), /lask:doctor with a compact CLAUDE.md autonomy block (stop rule, TASKS.md long runs, one subagent per unit, design avoid list), a destructive-command guard, hook-enforced model tiering (opus default, sonnet for spec'd implementation and mechanical work, no fable), Codex job UX, the voice-input skill (Windows dictation into Claude with CapsWriter-Offline and Qwen3-ASR on CPU), and /lask:clip (sends the clipboard as one message when a terminal such as herdr types a paste out key by key).
